paragraphs: Chapter 839
Episode 209. Temar's Seventh Tomb - Kaitam's Painting (12)
A thousand years ago, Temar and Murakan.

The place they were standing was the Storm Castle. Not the picture of the Storm Castle, which was completely destroyed in the recent battle with the imposter, but the Storm Castle from a thousand years ago, which still stands on the top of Mount Murakan.
Jin and the ten knights opened their eyes wide to inspect the new landscape, while Murakan turned his gaze away, tearing at his chest.
“No... this can't be. Yes, there's no way I could have done such a thing. This Murakan wouldn't have tried to kill the knights, Temar, and you.”
Jin was worried as it seemed like Murakan was losing his sanity. He repeatedly repeated the words he just said.
'I feel like he could go berserk at any moment. Murakan's aura is more unstable than before.'
Soon, a spear was formed in the aura behind Murakan. The spear shot straight into the landscape of a thousand years ago, but the landscape was not affected at all.
Right now, they can only observe the landscape of a thousand years ago as observers, and they cannot exert any influence.
The phrase ‘It's all your doing’ that was heard just now was addressed to the Murakan in the landscape, not the real Murakan.
The Murakan in the landscape was gritting his teeth without answering Temar.
“Murakan, stop.”
It was Dranax. He looked back and forth at Murakan and the Murakan from a thousand years ago and Temar with a serious gaze.

"We may only be guardians, but our souls must be just as real as they were a thousand years ago. So, the three of us have the right to know what happened then. You can't destroy the landscape anyway, so calm down and stay still."
"That's right, Murakan. We will perish soon, but we want to see it with our own eyes at least once before that. Our history that we don't know."
Frey also was watching the landscape without taking her eyes off it, overcoming the pain. The ten knights decided to refuse to disappear until they confirmed the truth.
"This is... a plot. The witch, or someone else... Yes, Lokia. Lokia betrayed us. It's their plot, to frame me! How could I kill you? How could I harm Temar and massacre innocent people like that?”
Painful memories can drive a person mad.
Murakan was being eroded by old memories that were rushing in unavoidably.
But Jin decided not to add more words to Murakan. He had already said what he had to say to him.
Whatever the truth is, let's deal with it together with him and his comrades.
Jin and the ten knights fixed their gaze on the landscape, leaving the crouched Murakan behind.
"When I first heard that you were trying to kill your comrades, I didn't believe it. Even the one who told me was Lokia, and as you know, I was suspicious of Lokia."
"Temar."

"But Lokia did not betray us. He was just constantly in contact with the witch trying to find a solution to my curse. But to think that you... you would stab us in the back like this... you and Solderet."
"Enough, Temar. I did not kill you for the sake of being a Contractor of a thousand years, or for Solderet. Do you truly not know?"

"Oh, so you're still saying that I'm mad? Just like when you brought my sister and Padler to the Tower of the Black Sea to kill me. I've completely regained my sanity since then. I remember clearly the many truths I saw through the witch while I was mad. I guess that's why Solderet wants to handle me."
"......There's no need for further words. Temar, I won't apologize. This is the best I can do."

"A thousand years. We were destined to be used and discarded like consumables for the future a thousand years later chosen by Solderet. The one who becomes the Contractor then will not know this dark truth at all. Today, your and your god's hideous deeds end. I will stop you. If you cannot stop."
Whoosh...!
When Temar drew his sword, the interior of the storm enveloping the two instantly darkened. The spirit energy he emanated was creating a vast subspace endlessly.
Under Temar's gaze, the humanoid Murakan split vertically and dispersed into spirit energy. The energy soon flew far away and reformed into Murakan's original form.

The continued repulsion momentarily tore the subspace, revealing the outside scenery. It was a point in the Murakan mountain range, quite far from the storm. The torn space was quickly filled with spirit energy again.
'It's a sword similar to the false arrival of darkness. Did Temar and Murakan keep battling in this subspace like this... and the Murakan mountain range completely disappeared.'
The fight with the fake was nothing compared to their battle. Temar and Murakan, both had clear power of creation in every strike.

With a single sword stroke, a chunk of the mountain range was cut off, and with a single breath, an empty city where no one remained disappeared. It seemed as if not a human and a dragon, but two gods who could control the world at will were opposing each other.

Murakan was still crouched and murmuring unintelligible words. The Ten Knights barely suppressed their discomfort at the sight of the two fighting in the scenery. The scene they were witnessing now was no different from when the fake Murakan attacked Temar.
"So they had such a conversation. It really seems Murakan did attack the master. Just like we knew it here......"
"I won't make any judgments until I see the end. Jin and Murakan, they came to us and helped us. They allowed us to remove the fake Murakan we believed was real and see the truth."
"That's right."
"I wonder if Frey can confess her unfinished feelings to that crushed guy even after seeing the end. A love confession should never turn into curses and slander."
"You're talking nonsense again... Viol. If I were in good shape, I would have definitely punched you..."
"Frey, you're still bleeding. Even if we're on the verge of disappearing, the end should be somewhat comfortable. Save your breath. Ignore Viol's nonsense."
Of course, Jin already knew the winner of this battle.
Murakan would eventually be defeated by Temar, and fall into a long sleep for a thousand years.

Already, the Temar and Murakan in the scenery have exchanged more than a hundred attacks. Whenever the subspace was torn, the outside that was revealed was nothing but destroyed mountain ranges and cities, and strangely torn dark clouds and storms.
Temar was mainly on the attack, and Murakan focused on defense. Murakan was certain that he could win if the battle dragged on.
Temar was bound to get tired eventually, while Murakan never got tired. As long as his heart wasn't damaged, his strength would be infinite and the same as it was at first.
"You keep trying to move the battlefield out of the mountains.... I suppose it wouldn't matter to you if people get caught in our fight and die."
"...No one lives near my mountain range now."

"Near the mountains that run through the whole of Hupester, there's no one... Are you proud of it? You've so mercilessly trampled on those who worshipped you. It's okay to turn their homes into ashes, but you don't like it when your house is broken?"
Contrary to the real Murakan writhing in agony, the Murakan from a thousand years ago seemed unaffected by Temar's malicious words.

Murakan was only focused on killing Temar, all senses on high alert. Like the fake Murakan, he went into awakening, forming a pair of wings, and constantly releasing spirit energy from his enlarged horns.

The Murakan mountain range that leads to the upper part of Mitel is now completely gone, leaving only traces. Landslides and earthquakes spread throughout Mitel, and destruction showed no signs of stopping.
Just like their collapsed relationship, it was falling apart irreversibly.
The observers couldn't tell how much time had passed during the fight. This was because the perspective was changing from time to time.
But every time it changed, all that appeared was the two people fighting in the subspace created by Temar's spirit sword.

The observers could only perceive the changing perspective by the wounds that appeared on Temar that weren't there before, and the changing outside scenery revealed little by little when the subspace tore apart.
There was no sign of Murakan being hurt or tired.
[Further fighting is meaningless, Temar. What is being destroyed in this fight is everything we wanted to protect. The land of Runcandel, where the people under Runcandel's protection live.]
"How dare you mention what we wanted to protect with that filthy mouth."

[I just want to say that we should leave a little more of this land and the people living on it for the future. If there's still a heart in you that loves this family and this land. Stop and accept death.]

"Future... I don't care about such a thing. Thanks to you and Solderet, we've already lost our present. And as long as you and Solderet exist, Runcandel can never be free. It will forever be used by Solderet."
[Our enemy is Zipfel, not Solderet......]
"That's right, until he showed his true colors. Now you guys are more disgusting and abhorrent than Zipfel. It's almost maddening how pathetic me and my comrades who gave everything to you guys are."
Murakan's suggestion to stop the meaningless fight and accept death did not agree.
From Temar's standpoint, there was no reason to prolong the fight. He had to decide the victory before his stamina fell even further.
And for when to decide the victory, Temar was constantly preparing one sword.
Even if the enemy is stronger than himself, with willpower alone, a spirit sword that can overcome the gap and cut the opponent.
Spirit Sword Technique 1, Soul Slash.
Temar's sword, Barisada, stained black, was pointed at Murakan.
"It's time for you to pay, Murakan. Suffer. Remember the ones you killed......"
Temar swung his sword with a malicious smile.
